title: How far does light go?
description:
Light travels about 299,792 kilometres every second. Read a number of **days** and print how many kilometres light covers in that time:

```
In 1 days light travels 25902028800 km
```

The answer overflows a 32-bit `int` straight away, so choose your types with care. Use named variables for the speed of light and the seconds in a day rather than bare numbers (in lesson 2.06 you will learn to lock them with `const`).
hints: If every value in the multiplication is a 64-bit integer, the result is too. If you multiply two plain `int`s first, that part can overflow before it is ever widened.
